mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CURRENCY_COUNTRY_MAP ( countryKey, currencyCd, countryNmEN, currencyNmEN, isUse ) VALUES ( #{countryCd}, #{currencyCd}, #{countryNm}, #{currencyNm}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE isUse = 1

INSERT INTO CURRENCY_VOLUME_MAP ( countryKey, relativeCountryKey, afterRatio, today ) VALUES ( #{countryKey}, #{relativeCountryKey}, #{afterRatio}, #{today} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE afterRatio = #{afterRatio}, today = #{today}
